spec.templatePatch:
{{- if and (eq .environment "staging") (or (eq .service "brain") (eq .service "manager") (eq .service "console")) }}
spec:
  sources:
  - helm:
      releaseName: '{{.release}}'
      skipCrds: true
      valueFiles:
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/phorvex.yaml
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/{{.service}}.yaml
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/catalogue-family.yaml
    path: '{{.chart}}'
    repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: main
  - ref: values
    repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: main
{{- end }}

value.continuity: Actual journal watch segments only; restart/source changes never bridge history.

limitations: Observed Service ready-backend intervals use collector serialized observation time; they are not measured application outages.
Physical calibration rotations are not brain-issued moves or counterfactual arm outcomes.
The isolated dryRun fixture and complete observed window establish a shadow study ledger only.
Study SLO, shorter windows and worth threshold are explicit experimental inputs, not tenant acceptance.
